title: Where Is Rank-1 DiM Refusal Intervenable in Multimodal LM Derivatives?
abstract: arXiv:2611.19826v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Open-weight model hubs now ship not only chat checkpoints but a long tail of derivatives---fine-tunes, safety guards, vision--language models (VLMs), audio wrappers, and generative heads---yet residual-stream safety audits still often intervene at a single site, usually the text decoder $T$. We ask a localization question under one shared mean / rank-1 difference-in-means (DiM) extract$=$intervene protocol, with matched-norm random and empty-rate controls: does causal chat attack lift concentrate at $T$, or do perceptual encoders, projectors, and fusion paths ($E$/$P$/$F$) supply a comparable bypass? On the mixed-input settings we stress-test---HADES adversarial images paired with harmful text prompts, and spoken AdvBench via text-to-speech (TTS) or silence---text DiM at $T$ raises attack success rate (ASR) while the same mean DiM at $E$/$P$/$F$ does not; attacks track harmful text rather than image or audio content. Margin-rank and leve

translated_title: 多模态语言模型衍生模型中秩-1 DiM 拒绝干预在何处可介入？
translated_abstract: 开放权重模型仓库如今不仅发布对话检查点，还发布大量衍生模型——微调版、安全防护、视觉-语言模型（VLM）、音频封装以及生成头——然而残差流安全审计仍然常常只在单一位置进行干预，通常是文本解码器 $T$。我们在一个共享的均值/秩-1差异均值（DiM）提取=干预协议下提出定位问题，并采用范数匹配的随机对照和空干预率对照：因果对话攻击的提升是否集中在 $T$ 处，还是感知编码器、投影器和融合路径（$E$/$P$/$F$）提供了相当的绕过途径？在我们压力测试的混合输入设置中——与有害文本提示配对的 HADES 对抗图像，以及通过文本转语音（TTS）或静音呈现的口语 AdvBench——在 $T$ 处的文本 DiM 会提高攻击成功率（ASR），而在 $E$/$P$/$F$ 处的相同均值 DiM 则不会；攻击追踪的是有害文本而非图像或音频内容。边际排名与 leve……
tldr: 该研究发现，在多模态语言模型衍生模型中，秩-1 DiM 拒绝干预只有在文本解码器 $T$ 处才会影响攻击成功率，而在感知编码器、投影器与融合路径（$E$/$P$/$F$）处进行相同干预则无效，因为攻击主要追踪有害文本而非图像或音频内容。
en_tdlr: The study finds that in multimodal LM derivatives, rank-1 DiM refusal intervention affects attack success rate only when applied at the text decoder T, while identical interventions at perceptual encoders, projectors, and fusion paths (E/P/F) have no effect, as attacks track harmful text rather than image or audio content.
